criteria_results.text: An exact-owner projectless desktop human chat is interactive from mobile, while retaining projectId null and using a separate registered-project routing context for gateway authorization.
criteria_results.notes: User report: why is it still saying read only? i want to be able to interact with it.

criteria_results.text: The Opening chat screen always exposes Back to chats, which cancels the in-flight open and returns to Agents.
criteria_results.notes: User report: there is no way to back out of the opening chat loading screen.

criteria_results.text: Opening a chat becomes ready after its bounded message page loads; diff, todos, permissions, and questions refresh afterward and cannot hold the opening screen hostage.
criteria_results.notes: User report: it is loading, for a long time. does not feel like its going to connect.

criteria_results.text: Chats publishes the first 10 owner sessions immediately, then merges remaining owner pages and project batches progressively without keeping the initial list loader active.
criteria_results.notes: User report: it takes a while to load initial sessions list too; maybe it only needs to load 10 at a time, the first ten quick, but then the rest on delay.

issues.description: The prior handoff described projectless chats as openable and bounded after automated verification, but the physical-device journey still exposed read-only state, blocking supplemental loads, and no cancellation path.
issues.detected_by: Physical-iPhone user smoke after the passing CI and live backend checks.

failure_output: Projectless chats were labeled read-only; opening waited indefinitely without Back; the initial session catalog remained behind one eager full-load spinner.
suggested_follow_up: Gate mobile chat delivery on an automated progressive-discovery and full interactive open journey that proves first-page latency, cancellation, messages-first readiness, and owner-authorized prompting.
